title: Kenyan-Style Lamb Kebabs with Crisp Salad
description: A flavorful and refreshing recipe featuring marinated lamb kebabs served with a hearty and crisp salad. This Kenyan-inspired dish is perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the lamb into uniform pieces for even cooking.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice is best.

ingredients.name: minced garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic just before using it to get the best flavor.

ingredients.name: grated ginger
ingredients.notes: Use fresh ginger for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: curry powder
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality curry powder for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of lettuce, spinach, and other greens for a hearty salad.

ingredients.name: cherry tomatoes, halved
ingredients.notes: Use fresh cherry tomatoes for the best flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: crunchy tortilla strips
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade tortilla strips for added crunch.

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they are evenly coated.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until they are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the kebabs are cooking, prepare the salad by combining the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and crunchy tortilla strips in a large bowl.
Once the kebabs are cooked, remove them from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve the kebabs on top of the salad and enjoy!
Note: Make sure to cook the lamb to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to ensure food safety.
